description.value: A 30-site BC Parks campground on Sowchea Bay in the Cariboo/Central Interior, with potable water and washrooms; the gate closes in the off-season so this is a strictly summer destination.

address.value: Sowchea Rd, Bulkley-Nechako, BC V0J 1P0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL resolves to a live BC Parks page for Sowchea Bay Park, confirming the campground is a real, operating provincial park. However, the fetched content is almost entirely navigation menus with no park-specific amenity detail, making it impossible to confirm any specific facilities. OSM tags provide explicit negatives for internet_access (no) and power_supply (no), but per the rules these cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration, so amenities default to null. A notable discrepancy exists: the OSM operator is 'Quartz Contracting' with an AOL email, while the website is BC Parks — likely a contractor arrangement, but worth flagging.
concerns: OSM operator is 'Quartz Contracting' with contact email northquartz@aol.com, but the listed website is a BC Parks government page — likely a contractor-operated park, but the operator contact details may not match BC Parks reservation processes.
Website content returned was almost entirely navigation menus with no park-specific amenity information; all subpages tested returned 404 errors, leaving amenities unverifiable.

Phone number (+1-250-964-3489) and email (northquartz@aol.com) appear to belong to the private contractor Quartz Contracting, not BC Parks — cyclists may need to contact BC Parks directly for reservations.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating BC Parks provincial campground with 30 sites; the live BC Parks website page confirms it is not closed or defunct.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags indicate capacity of 30 sites, fee required, no power supply, no internet access, and no sanitary dump station, but these could not be independently confirmed from the website content.
